description.zh:
数据源环境类型，枚举值：
- Dev：开发环境
- Prod：生产环境
description.en:
The environment in which the data sources are used. Valid values:

- Dev: development environment

- Prod: production environment

description.zh: 数据源名称，基于此名称做模糊查询。
description.en: The name of the data source. Fuzzy match by data source name is supported.

description.zh:
数据源列表排序方向，枚举值：
- Desc：倒序
- Asc：正序

默认值：Desc
description.en:
The order in which you want to sort the data sources. Valid values:

- Desc: descending order

- Asc: ascending order

Default value: Desc

description.zh: 查询第几页，默认值为1表示第一页。
分页大小，默认值为10，最大值100。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。

该参数用来确定本次API调用操作使用的DataWorks工作空间。
description.en:
The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID.

You must configure this parameter to specify the DataWorks workspace to which the API operation is applied.

description.zh:
数据源列表排序字段，支持名称、创建时间、数据源ID排序
- CreateTime：创建时间
- Id：数据源ID
- Name：数据源名称

默认值：CreateTime
description.en:
The field that you want to use to sort the data sources. Valid values:

- CreateTime

- Id

- Name

Default value: CreateTime

description.zh:
数据源可以打标签，基于标签做数据源查询过滤：
- 多个值之间是“且”的关系，比如`["tag1", "tag2", "tag3"]`底层查询同时有这3个标签打标的数据源列表。
- 不传递，或者传递为空表示不作tag过滤，查询最多支持10个标签。
description.en:
The tag of the data source. This parameter specifies a filter condition.

- You can specify multiple tags, which are in the logical AND relation. For example, you can query the data sources that contain the following tags: `["tag1", "tag2", "tag3"]`.

- If you do not configure this parameter, tag-based filtering is not performed. You can specify up to 10 tags.

description.zh: 数据源类型查询过滤，可以配置多个类型查询过滤。
description.en: The data source types. This parameter specifies a filter condition. You can specify multiple data source types.

descriptions.zh:
1. 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
2. 需要在DataWorks项目空间中具有如下至少一种角色：
- 租户所有者、空间管理员、部署、开发、访客、项目所有者、运维、模型设计师、安全管理员、数据分析师、开发平台管理员、数据治理管理员
descriptions.en:
1. This operation is available for all DataWorks editions.

2. To call this operation, you must have one of the following roles in DataWorks:

- Tenant Owner, Workspace Administrator, Deploy, Develop, Visitor, Workspace Owner, O\&M, Model Designer, Security Administrator, Data Analyst, OpenPlatform Administrator, and Data Governance Administrator

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-data-sources --project-id 17820 --name test --types mysql --env-type Prod --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sort-by CreateTime --order Desc --tags tag1_,_tag2_,_tag3 --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListDataSources --region cn-hangzhou --Order Desc --Types mysql --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --SortBy CreateTime --ProjectId 17820 --EnvType Prod --Tags 'tag1_,_tag2_,_tag3' --Name test
